answer.justification: The space posterior to the stomach is the lesser sac (omental bursa). It is accessed by incising the gastrohepatic ligament, part of the lesser omentum between the lesser curvature of the stomach and the liver. The phrenoesophageal ligament and phrenicocolic ligament are peritoneal reflections near the esophageal hiatus and splenic pole, while the ligamentum venosum is a nonperitoneal hepatic structure.
